skills.name: Addition
skills.description: Add whole numbers accurately.

skills.name: Subtraction
skills.description: Subtract whole numbers accurately.

skills.name: Multiplication
skills.description: Multiply whole numbers accurately.

skills.name: Order of operations
skills.description: Evaluate expressions using multiplication before addition and parentheses first.

skills.name: Division
skills.description: Divide whole numbers accurately.

skills.name: Unknown numbers
skills.description: Find a unique integer unknown by undoing addition, subtraction, or multiplication.

skills.name: Understand one half
skills.description: Recognize and use one half of a quantity.

skills.name: Find the whole from one half
skills.description: Determine a whole quantity when one half is known.

skills.name: Identify known information
skills.description: Extract the important known quantities from a word problem.

skills.name: Identify the unknown
skills.description: Determine what quantity the problem asks the student to find.

skills.name: Reverse reasoning
skills.description: Work backwards from a final known quantity to an earlier unknown quantity.

skills.name: Generated story problems
skills.description: Solve generated Grade 4 word problems with several operations, comparisons, or reverse reasoning.

skills.name: Reverse addition
skills.description: Undo an addition operation using subtraction.

skills.name: Reverse subtraction
skills.description: Undo a subtraction operation using addition.

skills.name: Reverse multiplication
skills.description: Undo multiplication using division.

skills.name: Reverse division
skills.description: Undo division using multiplication.

skills.name: Arithmetic sequences
skills.description: Find the common difference and the next term of an arithmetic sequence.

skills.name: Operation chains
skills.description: Follow or reverse a short chain of addition, subtraction, and multiplication.

skills.name: Recursive digit patterns
skills.description: Determine later digits from rules involving previous digits.

skills.name: Digit constraints
skills.description: Use digit limits and logical constraints to find valid numbers.

skills.name: Logical reasoning
skills.description: Solve Grade 4 number clues, quantity relationships, and deduction puzzles.
